name: negative feedback loop with a buffer node, enzymes on B closer to saturation (NFBLB)
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Ma, Trusina, El-Samad, Lim and Tang, Cell 138, 760 (2009), doi:10.1016/j.cell.2009.06.013: Eqs. (1) and (5); Michaelis constants and rates on B and C from the Fig. 3 legend

assumptions: rate constants and Michaelis constants not stated in the main text (k_IA, K_IA, k'_FAA, K'_FAA and the others named in model_sheet.md) set to 1, the centre of the sampled ranges (0.1-10 and 0.001-100)
basal enzymes F_A = F_B = 0.5 (as in the source)
the input renamed Iin; step 0.5 -> 0.6 as in the source
Fig. 3A, middle panel: K_CB = K'_FBB = 0.01, k_AC = k'_BC = 10

drift.A: Iin*kIA*(1 - A)/((1 - A) + KIA) - FA*kFA*A/(A + KFA)
drift.B: C*kCB*(1 - B)/((1 - B) + KCB) - FB*kFB*B/(B + KFB)
drift.C: A*kAC*(1 - C)/((1 - C) + KAC) - B*kBC*C/(C + KBC)

observable: active fraction of the output node C
